sota_sync.description: Sincroniza Manifesto dos Agentes para a Realidade Fisica

payload_b64.description: String codificada em Base64 contendo o JSON da nova Task

active_players.description: Numero de jogadores ativos no pote

args: from engine.vitoi_perspective_engine import VitoiPerspectiveEngine; import json, sys; res = VitoiPerspectiveEngine.evaluate_vitoi_theorems(equity={equity}, pot_size={pot_size}, stack_eff_bb={stack_eff_bb}, position='{position}', active_players={active_players}); print(json.dumps(res, indent=2))
